name: B3 schematic editing set
description: Opens an isolated software fixture project and drives the schematic editing set (Phase 1 slice B3) with real X input: places two parts at different heights, Ctrl+A selects both, Edit > Align top edges is one Batch, Ctrl+D duplicates both as one Batch and one Undo removes both copies (one undo step). A right-click on a part opens the canvas context menu generated from the action registry (Copy, Align, Group shown unavailable), Escape closes it; a right-click on the empty sheet offers Paste and Find and replace. Ctrl+F opens find and replace and finds the designators. The right dock's Filter tab shows the selection filter; with Parts switched off Ctrl+A selects nothing.
